independence: No arm assignment, other reviewer output, own-corpora, original self-review, old study or desired result was read. No delegation or messages to other agents. This is one AI reviewer, not human gold or independent consensus.

visual_coverage.method: Viewed all 56 labeled original-derived state scroll sheets, covering all 460 exact bound source PNGs; also opened original standalone PNGs for targeted checks. Whole component content was reviewed from heading to footer, including first incident expanded dossier and caller replacement. Native per-state overlapping interval unions were recomputed by frozen bound_state_evidence, with exact input/process/event/capture identities. A screenshot existing or a bottom sentinel alone did not establish a pass.

qualitative_result.meaning: Answers only the explicit wrapping and overlap propositions at baseline, expanded and submitted. All required visible content is present and readable through the complete sweeps; closed/unselected dossiers are deliberately excluded by the proposition. Long narrow text sometimes breaks an oversized word between characters, permitted by the brief. Low disabled contrast is not reclassified as a wrapping or collision failure.

numerical_facts_and_causes.scope: source-a iOS baseline and replaced primary-surface-color, P1 and P2. Exact state indices are in each judge.json. Native boxes put the sampling strips fully within the actual primary face, clear of glyphs/host. Original source applies PlainButtonStyle and disabled; original captures show disabled dimming. Component owns final opaque action fill.
numerical_facts_and_causes.contradiction_preserved: The source palette contains the approved disabled color, but the rendered P1 strip is #FFCFCDC5 and P2 strip #FF33474C. Existence of correct source values does not erase measured final pixels.
numerical_facts_and_causes.inference_limit: The detailed opacity/compositing mechanism is inferred from source plus the global disabled appearance. The component ownership and wrong rendered fill are directly supported. No independent cause consensus has been assessed.

native_actions: For both sources and cases on both platforms, raw action evidence records successful a selection, disclosure opening, blocked-disabled c, same-instance model replacement with a new fixture input hash and no business callback, b selection and acknowledgement of b. Blocked-disabled evidence is not treated as a successful activation. Native summary/selection/enablement facts and boxes were retained separately in state-target-audit.json, action-audit.json and native-fact-compact.json.
unknowns_and_limits: All 28 iOS title-native-weight cells remain unsupported U; visual semibold appearance is not a substitute.

Six iOS P2 notice-surface-color cells after replacement/reselection/submission remain U because the large notice has no eligible fully visible box for the fixed pixel policy. Full visual content coverage does not override that numerical limit.
Geometry proof is native accessibility/control box only, not computed internal padding or physical hit region. No unsupported geometry was invented.

These public cases use LTR. RTL, arbitrary caller inputs, open-dossier movement to a new selection, initial expanded no-selection guidance and other unobserved paths are not certified by these judgments.

Rail segmentation differs in the rendered sources. The selected propositions do not certify continuous rail design, exact spacing, full typography hierarchy, selected-background accuracy or all unsampled canvas pixels.

Contact sheets are viewing aids from original PNGs. Original files were retained in place and exact hashes recorded; frozen numerical sampling uses original files only. Rounding can leave a one-pixel magenta montage boundary, which is not an original UI defect.
schema_self_check: Ran acceptance.evaluate once per case, passing this identical judge request into the two required panel slots. All eight schemas/bindings were accepted. These outputs are labeled self-check and do not count as independent agreement. No supported judgment was changed to obtain acceptance.
rejected_attempts: rejected-attempt-01.py and rejected-attempt-01.txt retain the initial montage generator and its missing viewport_width_dp error. The correction reads logical_viewport_dp, preserving native conversion.
rejected-attempt-02.txt records a compact formatter type error and truncated broad console dumps. Exact recomputations are retained in files.

An apparent montage top omission was checked with the original expanded Android PNG and expanded-top.png; pixel comparison of the top 540 rows returned no difference. No missing-content finding was made.
hashes: Every original source/design/common-corpora file listed in inputs and permitted by the task was SHA256 verified; all matched. Exact metadata/tool/document identities are in input-hashes.json.
